Title: Restore or retire Beach Body Igniter Stack
Problem: Bundle PDP renders every variant as sold out/unavailable with ATC disabled, while advertising -30% ($179.97 to $125.98). Highest-AOV page converts at zero.
Acceptance Criteria: Bundle ATC enabled with at least one purchasable combination; discount shown as savings vs component sum not bare -30%; if not restockable short-term, unpublish and 301 to /collections/stacks-bundles
Suggested App: Shopify Bundles (free) or rebuild via Rebuy

Title: Back-in-stock capture on sold-out variants
Problem: Quattro 3/5 flavors and Limitless 1/4 sold out with no recapture; sold-out swatches dead-end.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting a sold-out flavor swaps ATC for 'Notify me when back' email capture; captured emails sync to Klaviyo with product + variant tags
Suggested App: Back in Stock / Restock Rocket or Klaviyo Back-in-Stock

Title: Default to Subscribe & Save + flexibility copy
Problem: PDP defaults to One-time purchase; 15% subscription is an unframed radio. Ghost/PVL/TL all default ON.
Acceptance Criteria: Selling-plan group renders with subscribe pre-selected; microcopy: $XX.XX/order, 15% off every order, cancel/pause/skip anytime; one-time stays one click away

Title: Trust strip under Add-to-Cart
Problem: No guarantee, testing badge, or risk reversal near CTA; only audited brand showing none of guarantee/third-party/per-serving.
Acceptance Criteria: Theme block below ATC: satisfaction guarantee + free-ship threshold + Kosher/gluten-free/dye-free badges; reusable across PDPs via section setting

Title: Per-serving cost framing at price
Problem: No 'as low as $X/serving' line; $69.99 Quattro has no value anchor vs cheaper whey.
Acceptance Criteria: Price block shows 'as low as $X.XX/serving' from servings metafield / price; uses subscription price when subscribe is selected

Title: Enrich sticky Add-to-Cart bar
Problem: Mobile sticky bar shows only 'Add to cart' - no thumbnail, price, or selected variant; forces scroll-up to confirm.
Acceptance Criteria: Sticky bar carries featured image + product title + live price + selected flavor/size; price updates on variant/subscription change

Title: Outcome-led benefit bullets above the fold
Problem: Strongest differentiator (zero bloat, lactose-friendly) is buried in a feature list.
Acceptance Criteria: 3-4 icon bullets below ATF (e.g. Zero gas/bloating, 30g 4-source protein, Lactose-friendly, Kosher & gluten-free); pre-workout gets its own set; editable per product

Title: Complete Your Stack with real bundle discount
Problem: Cross-sell row exists (Quattro to Primer/Limitless/Nektr w/ ratings + ATC) but is unframed with no incentive.
Acceptance Criteria: Row reframed as 'Complete Your Stack - save X%' with automatic discount when 2+ items added together; pre-curated stack per hero product
Suggested App: Rebuy or Shopify Bundles + automatic discount

Title: Review volume + photo/UGC + Q&A program
Problem: Quattro 43 / Limitless 15 reviews - an order of magnitude behind TL (4,965) and 1st Phorm (37,340). No UGC photos or Q&A.
Acceptance Criteria: Post-purchase review-request flow with photo incentive; widget shows star breakdown, filters, verified-buyer tag, photo UGC, Q&A block; migrate existing reviews

Title: Ingredient callout cards + structured facts
Problem: Supplement facts served as flat images (13 detected); no clinically-dosed callouts, no third-party signal.
Acceptance Criteria: 2-3 callout cards above facts image (ingredient, dose, why); badge any third-party/Kosher/GMP testing; render facts as accessible text/table where feasible w/ image fallback

Title: In-gallery product video
Problem: Zero video on any Magnum PDP; TL (2 videos), HD Muscle, and 1st Phorm all embed it. Mixability is a top protein objection.
Acceptance Criteria: One 10-15s mixability/lifestyle clip as gallery slide 2 on Quattro and Limitless via native Shopify product media

Title: Premium education block + product FAQ
Problem: Accordions are functional but light on 'why it works'; doesn't justify premium price vs cheaper whey.
Acceptance Criteria: 'Why 4-source protein digests better' explainer on Quattro; mechanism explainer on Limitless; product-specific FAQ accordion (mixability, lactose, timing, stacking) distinct from generic site FAQ

Title: Klaviyo wiring (enabler)
Problem: Prerequisite for back-in-stock, review-request, and post-purchase flows.
Acceptance Criteria: Klaviyo installed/confirmed and connected to Shopify; flows available for MAG-002 and MAG-009

Title: Build Phase 1 changes as reusable section/metafield blocks
Problem: Phase 1 wins (trust strip, per-serving, benefit bullets, sticky bar, subscription default) must apply catalog-wide, not hardcoded on Quattro/Limitless.
Acceptance Criteria: Each Phase 1 block is section/metafield-driven and rolls to all PDPs; no per-product hardcoding
